integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the reflection-cover lower bound from the subgroup structure, identifies when the \(p\) maximal dihedral reflection classes also cover all prime-order rotations, and verifies that the extremal constructions induce cliques. The paired formula then follows from parity plus explicit one-vertex extensions in the two odd cases, separated by whether \(p^2\mid n\).
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary dihedral groups and the subgroup intersection graph on proper nontrivial subgroups.
The result gives minimum cardinalities but does not enumerate all minimum total or paired dominating sets.
The finite verifier covers parameters 3 through 20 only; the general theorem is proved symbolically.
title: Total and paired domination in dihedral subgroup intersection graphs
